title: Best.
body: When I realized that I wanted to use mobile apps to develop habits, I downloaded Me+. It was great before the update, then I started looking for a new one. Many did not fit and finally I found this application. It's perfect! An interesting interface, pleasant background music, there is motivation, I really like the way everything is designed, it's great, the sound effects are mesmerizing. Thanks!
